name: /waitlist export + smoke test daily cron scheduler
block: Phase 2A — Achiri alpha prep + Phase 1 pipeline health
goal: Two small but high-value additions: (1) /waitlist export: owner-only subcommand that outputs all waitlist chatIds as a comma-separated string ready to paste into ACHIRI_ALPHA_WHITELIST env var. Eliminates manual JSONL parsing on Apr 25 launch day. (2) Smoke test cron: PM2 entry (kognai-smoke-test) runs scripts/smoke-test-pipeline.ts daily at 06:00 UTC, 1hr before the daily digest, so the digest always has fresh smoke test data.
rationale: /waitlist export: Apr 25 operator workflow is: /waitlist export → copy string → paste as ACHIRI_ALPHA_WHITELIST in .env → restart PM2. Without export, must parse JSONL manually. Smoke test cron: daily digest reads smoke-test-latest.json. If no cron, the report goes stale and the digest shows outdated data. 06:00 cron fires 1hr before 07:00 digest.
swarm: NOT USED — 1 function edit (commands.ts) + 1 config edit (ecosystem.config.js). Direct write.

tasks.title: agents/telegram-bot/commands.ts — /waitlist export subcommand
tasks.description: In handleWaitlist(), add 'export' case: if subCmd === 'export' and chatId === ownerChatId: load waitlist.jsonl, format chatIds as comma-separated string (e.g. '12345,67890,11111'), send as code block with count. Message: 'ACHIRI_ALPHA_WHITELIST=<comma-ids>\nTotal: N users'. If empty: 'Waitlist is empty.'. Not authorized for non-owners.

tasks.title: ecosystem.config.js — kognai-smoke-test PM2 cron (06:00 daily)
tasks.description: Add PM2 entry named 'kognai-smoke-test': script='scripts/smoke-test-pipeline.ts', cron_restart='0 6 * * *', autorestart=false. Fires at 06:00 UTC daily (1hr before digest). Uses same ts-node/register pattern as other Kognai entries. cwd=/Users/tarekmnif/kognai.
